slots.title: U.S. cash session — Oct. 23, 2026
slots.body:
The Dow Jones Industrial Average finished at 52,215.16, down 652.82 points (−1.2%), the largest index decline among the major U.S. benchmarks in the injected close data.
The S&P 500 closed at 7,622.86 (−0.5%) and the Nasdaq Composite at 25,955.34 (−0.2%).
The Russell 2000 ended at 2,775.90 (−0.3%).

Two U.S. activity and sentiment releases printed during the session window in the calendar data.
Michigan Consumer Sentiment (Oct) came in at 48.0 vs a 46.3 estimate and 48.1 prior.
S&P Global Manufacturing PMI (Oct) was 56.0 vs 55.5 estimate and 55.9 prior; Composite PMI 57.6 vs 57.6 estimate; Services PMI 57.9 vs 58.0 estimate.

Sector averages on Nasdaq split cleanly: Energy led at about +3.1%, Financial Services about +1.0%, and Technology about +0.8%.
Consumer Defensive lagged at about −1.3%, with Consumer Cyclical about −0.3% and Healthcare about −0.3%.

Oil and energy equities stood out.
Brent crude closed at 116.72 (+3.1%).
The USO ETF finished at 169.53 (+4.3%).
SLB rose 7.1% to 53.06 after EPS of $0.64 vs a $0.617 estimate and revenue of about $9.45B vs about $9.27B estimated.

Financials and select banks mixed to lower on the day while some report-driven names jumped.
American Express fell 3.7% to 313.03 despite EPS of $4.68 vs $4.50 estimate and revenue of about $20.06B vs about $20.12B estimated; coverage in the injected headlines also noted a 5% headcount reduction.
First Citizens BancShares (FCNCA) surged 8.2% to 2,375.84 on EPS of $55.37 vs $46.18 estimate.
Rithm Capital (RITM) gained 8.2% to 9.39 on EPS of $0.55 vs $0.499 estimate.

Megacap technology was mixed but several chip-linked names closed green after quieter AI-related trading was flagged in session coverage.
AMD +1.7% to 516.79, TSM +1.5% to 418.51, ASML +0.7% to 1,571.80, NVDA −0.6% to 210.96.
Alphabet (GOOGL) −1.2% to 320.21.

Consumer staples and related defensives were among the weaker megacap pockets: Coca-Cola −2.8% to 92.71, PepsiCo −2.2% to 135.77, Procter & Gamble −2.1% to 161.02, Costco −1.5% to 1,003.32.
AT&T, among actives, closed −8.0% at 20.93 in the injected actives list.

Other earnings in the bundle: Booz Allen Hamilton EPS $1.76 vs $1.48 estimate with revenue about $2.78B vs about $2.81B estimated (BAH −0.3% to 78.32).
MarketAxess EPS $1.86 vs $1.95 estimate (MKTX flat at 164.67).
Balchem EPS $1.57 vs $1.43 estimate (BCPC +2.2% to 177.00).

Cross-asset and risk gauges: gold futures (GCUSD) −1.3% to 4,007.90; the UUP dollar proxy +0.2% to 28.96; EUR/USD about 1.12 (−0.2% on the injected changes field); Bitcoin −0.2% to 80,916.76.
The VIX rose 2.2% to 19.45 (day range 18.87–20.66 in the index feed).

Treasury yields in the injected snapshot (dated 2026-10-21 in the bundle) showed the 10-year at 5.1% and the 2s10s spread at 0.32 percentage points.
Overseas indexes in the feed were mixed: Hang Seng +0.7%, Nikkei −0.3%, FTSE 100 −0.3%, with the Germany proxy (EWG) −1.0%.
